title: Three seasons of Best Model, and the statistics are not what wins it
title_zh: 三季的最佳模型獎，而贏的不是統計
lede: Every Best Model recipient of 2024, 2025 and 2026 read against the same twelve questions — 49 teams, 15 of them in the High School section. In each of the three seasons the winner was not the best-validated team on its slate, and twice the winner had the thinnest statistics. What the three winners share instead is that the model was load-bearing: delete it and the project falls over.
lede_zh: 2024、2025、2026 三季每一支得到最佳模型獎的隊伍，都用同樣十二個問題讀過一遍——49 支隊伍，其中 15 支在高中組。三季裡每一季的得獎者都不是那一季驗證做得最好的隊伍，而且有兩季的得獎者統計是整張名單裡最薄的。三位得獎者真正共有的是另一件事：模型是承重結構——把它拿掉，整個專案就垮了。
body:
**The roster first, because the category is small and fixed.** Best Model had 15 recipients in 2024, 16 in 2025 and 18 in 2026 — 49 in all, 9 outright winners and 40 nominees. The High School roster is **five slots a season**, one winner and four nominees, which over three seasons is 15 recipients and 12 distinct teams out of 128, 143 and 147 accepted. Repeat holders are GEMS-Taiwan, HK-Joint-School, GreatBay-SCIE and Lambert-GA, two seasons each.

**The inversion, and it happened three times.** In 2024 the winner was **IEA**, whose Model page carries no equation, no parameter table, no fitting method, no goodness-of-fit statistic, no validation and no numeric result — and still shows unedited iGEM boilerplate telling the reader to select the prize on the judging form. Three of the four nominees document more. In 2025 the winner was **GreatBay-SCIE**, with the thinnest statistics of its five: one R² and no error bars on anything computational. On the same slate **Lambert-GA** reported a temporal hold-out, leave-one-year-out cross-validation, AICc model selection across four candidate structures and Tukey 95% intervals — and was a nominee. In 2026 the winner was Lambert-GA, which reports **no RMSE, R² or residual statistic for any of its four models**, while the team with the strongest validation design of the seven we examined was **GEMS-Taiwan, not recognised in the category at all**. Three seasons, three times the same shape.

**What the three winners actually share.** First, the model is load-bearing. IEA's generative model emitted the enzyme sequences — it was the deliverable, not a commentary on it. Every one of GreatBay-SCIE's 18 wet-lab variants exists because a model ranked it. Lambert's 2026 pipeline produced the 35 candidates and then its own verdict demoted the flagship protein component in writing. Second, the computational work is published as something a stranger can pick up: IEA put fine-tuned weights and code under a Zenodo DOI; Lambert released PRINCE open source with three repositories, a CLI, a reproduction guide and its own benchmark over 6,937 interfaces in 1,549 clusters, including a published near-null of 0.648 against 0.645 for exposure alone. Third, new effort was spent to serve the model — IEA built a mass-spectrometry assay measuring expressibility across 8,000 proteins because the training data did not exist. Fourth, each published a null or a self-demotion.

**The model does not have to be about the headline claim.** Read the six Undergraduate and Overgraduate winners and **four of six won on a supporting quantity**. 2025 Peking ran eight models — dissolution, propulsion, adhesion, mucus penetration, binding, signalling, diffusion, epidemiology — and not one addressed the therapeutic efficacy its headline claimed. The 2026 Overgraduate winner, **Toronto, won on a negative result**: it asked whether protein-language-model embeddings predict PET-degrading activity under an honest split, answered no, printed ρ = 0.72 under a leaky split beside ρ = −0.025 under a grouped one, ran sequence length and amino-acid composition as dumb baselines and reported that the baselines win, and states that no library has yet been chosen by the model. A category award for a model that did not work, honestly reported.

**Publishing a failed prediction is the entry fee, not the edge.** Four of the five 2025 High School teams did it, all five of the recognised 2026 teams did it, five of the six university winners did it. So did the 2024 cohort. This converges with the falsification finding elsewhere in this report from the opposite direction: it is a floor, not a ranking. What is still free and still rare: **not one of the six university winners reports RMSE**, none reports chi-squared, R² appears on exactly one page, and three of six report no goodness-of-fit statistic with a value at all. Across all five recognised 2026 High School teams, no mechanistic model carries an R² or RMSE against the team's own data.

**Money is not the gate.** The 2026 Undergraduate winner, XJTLU-China, won on a CPU-only, pip-installable stack — NumPy, SciPy, pandas, Biopython, scikit-learn, Matplotlib — and its compute statement is one sentence naming a Windows x64 computer and CPython 3.14. Its whole advantage is methodological: splits grouped by gene and by promoter motif pair, numeric predictions stated in advance, an ablation ladder, a named held-out metric and a lockfile. In the High School section, HongKong-JSS reached 1st Runner-up on a laptop and about US$357 of hardware, and Mingdao took a Best Model slot on Python, Excel and a household glucose meter. Lambert's winning season cost **under US$400 of rented GPU** across 35 candidates. The things money cannot buy are real but narrow: an institutional HPC allocation, A100-class cards for days, hundreds of GPU-hours, production all-atom MD, structure prediction in the thousands, and a wet lab able to produce the measurement that settles the model.

**One shift is visible, and it has not reached the High School award yet.** All four of the 2024 and 2025 university winners had nothing held back from fitting. **Both 2026 university winners made held-out split design the centrepiece.** The High School section runs the same direction more slowly — 0 of 5 in 2024, 1 of 5 in 2025, 2 of 5 in 2026. But the 2026 High School award went to a team with no fit statistic, over a team with held-out years, a prospective test frozen before any county published, and a date-stamped pre-registration. Read the shift as a change in what will be expected, not as a change already priced in.

**GEMS-Taiwan across three seasons, which is the diagnosis.** In 2024, the Grand Prize year, the model was a **ten-equation SEI-SEIR vector-host system — a mechanistic model of its own intervention, and it was the headline claim**: 450 sticky ovitraps per 2,500 people halving dengue cases, 396 infected humans down to 192, stated as equivalent to vaccinating half the population with an 80%-efficacy vaccine. Twenty-five parameters carried a source column — 13 from one paper, 4 from another, **7 from the team's own wet lab**, 2 declared assumptions — and the fit was reported against itself, SSE 1.9029×10⁶ and RMSE 97.0582, with the deviation called significant. In 2025 the only thing actually fitted was a response surface for assay temperature and pH; the Michaelis-Menten, product-inhibition and Langmuir-Hinshelwood sections define their symbols and are **never parameterised** — no Vmax, Km or kcat appears anywhere, and the equations ship as images. In 2026 the statistical practice is the best in the field and there is **no mechanistic model of the engineered system at all**: the dynamics are a borrowed CcaSR Hill curve the wiki itself says nothing tests at 20 L, plus a published rule-based infection model, and the team's own fitted model is a statistical index over weather and county rice yield. The statistics improved every year and the model stopped being load-bearing. That is the whole trajectory, and it matches the award record exactly.
body_zh:
**先看名單，因為這個類別又小又固定。**最佳模型獎在 2024 年有 15 支受獎隊伍、2025 年 16 支、2026 年 18 支——合計 49 支，其中 9 支得獎、40 支入圍。高中組的名額是**每季五個**，一個得獎加四個入圍，三季下來是 15 支受獎、12 支不同隊伍，而三季的高中組參賽隊數分別是 128、143、147。重複拿到的有 GEMS-Taiwan、HK-Joint-School、GreatBay-SCIE 和 Lambert-GA，各兩季。

**那個顛倒，而且三季都發生。**2024 年的得獎者是 **IEA**，它的 Model 頁沒有方程式、沒有參數表、沒有擬合方法、沒有任何擬合統計量、沒有驗證、也沒有一個數值結果——而且還留著 iGEM 的原始樣板文字，叫讀者去評審表上勾選這個獎項。四支入圍隊伍裡有三支記錄得比它多。2025 年的得獎者是 **GreatBay-SCIE**，統計是五支裡最薄的：整頁一個 R²，所有計算結果都沒有誤差棒。而同一張名單上的 **Lambert-GA** 報了時間序列保留集、leave-one-year-out 交叉驗證、四種候選結構的 AICc 模型選擇，以及 Tukey 95% 區間——它是入圍。2026 年的得獎者是 Lambert-GA，它**四個模型全部沒有報 RMSE、R² 或任何殘差統計量**，而我們檢視的七支隊伍裡驗證設計最強的那一支是 **GEMS-Taiwan，在這個類別完全沒有被提及**。三季，同樣的形狀出現三次。

**三位得獎者真正共有的是什麼。**第一，模型是承重結構。IEA 的生成模型直接產出那些酵素序列——它就是交付成果本身，不是在旁邊註解它。GreatBay-SCIE 送進濕實驗室的 18 個變體，每一個都是因為模型排序才存在。Lambert 2026 年的流程產出 35 個候選，然後它自己的結論在文字上降級了自家旗艦的蛋白質工作。第二，計算工作是以「陌生人可以接手」的形式發表的：IEA 把微調後的權重和程式碼放在 Zenodo DOI 下；Lambert 把 PRINCE 開源，三個 repo、一個 CLI、一份重現指南，還有自己的基準測試——1,549 個群聚裡的 6,937 個界面，其中公開了一個幾乎為零的結果：0.648 對上「只看暴露度」的 0.645。第三，為了模型另外付出了新的勞力——IEA 做了一套質譜分析，量了 8,000 個蛋白質的可表現性，因為那份訓練資料本來不存在。第四，每一位都公開了一個空結果或自我降級。

**模型不必是頭條主張。**把六支大專組與研究生組的得獎者讀過一遍，**六支裡有四支是靠一個支援性的量得獎的**。2025 年的 Peking 跑了八個模型——溶離、推進、附著、黏液穿透、結合、訊息傳遞、擴散、流行病學——而沒有任何一個碰到它頭條所宣稱的治療效力。2026 年研究生組的得獎者 **Toronto 是靠一個否定結果得獎的**：它問「蛋白質語言模型的嵌入在一個誠實的切分下能不能預測 PET 降解活性」，答案是不能，並且把洩漏切分下的 ρ = 0.72 和分群切分下的 ρ = −0.025 並排印出來，再拿序列長度和胺基酸組成當笨基準線跑，然後報告說**基準線贏了**，並寫明至今沒有任何一個資料庫是由模型選出來的。一個做不出來的模型，誠實地寫出來，拿下了這個類別的獎。

**公開一個失敗的預測是入場費，不是優勢。**2025 年高中組五支裡有四支做了，2026 年受獎的五支全部做了，六支大學組得獎者裡有五支做了，2024 年那一批也是。這跟本報告在別處從相反方向得到的否證結論收斂到同一點：**它是地板，不是排名**。而還空在那裡、還很少見的是：**六支大學組得獎者沒有任何一支報 RMSE**、沒有一支報卡方、R² 只出現在一頁上，而六支裡有三支連一個帶數值的擬合統計量都沒有。2026 年受獎的五支高中隊伍裡，沒有任何一個機制模型帶著對照自己資料的 R² 或 RMSE。

**錢不是門檻。**2026 年大專組的得獎者 XJTLU-China，是靠一套**只用 CPU、pip 就裝得起來**的工具贏的——NumPy、SciPy、pandas、Biopython、scikit-learn、Matplotlib——它的算力宣告只有一句話，寫著一台 Windows x64 電腦和 CPython 3.14。它全部的優勢都在方法上：依基因、也依啟動子 motif 配對做分群切分、事先寫下數值預測、一組消融階梯、一個指名的保留集指標，以及一份 lockfile。而在高中組，HongKong-JSS 用一台筆電加大約 357 美元的硬體拿到第一亞軍，Mingdao 靠 Python、Excel 和一台家用血糖機拿下一個最佳模型席次。Lambert 得獎那一季，35 個候選的算力總共花了**不到 400 美元的租用 GPU**。錢買不到的東西是真的存在，但範圍很窄：機構級的 HPC 配額、連續數日的 A100 等級顯卡、數百 GPU 小時、量產級的全原子分子動力學、上千次的結構預測，以及一座做得出「能定案那個模型」的那個量測的濕實驗室。

**有一個轉變看得出來，而它還沒有抵達高中組的這個獎。**2024 與 2025 年四支大學組得獎者，全部沒有從擬合中保留任何資料。**2026 年兩支大學組得獎者都把保留集的切分設計當成整份投稿的核心。**高中組往同一個方向走，但慢得多——2024 年 0 比 5、2025 年 1 比 5、2026 年 2 比 5。可是 2026 年高中組這個獎，是給了一支沒有任何擬合統計量的隊伍，而沒有給那支有保留年份、有在任何縣市公布前就凍結的前瞻測試、還有日期戳記預先登記的隊伍。所以這個轉變要讀成「將來會被期待的事」，不是「已經被計入的事」。

**GEMS-Taiwan 的三季，而這就是診斷。**2024 年，總冠軍那一季，模型是一個**十條方程式的 SEI-SEIR 病媒—宿主系統——一個關於自己這套干預手段的機制模型，而且它就是頭條主張**：每 2,500 人放 450 個黏膠誘卵器可以把登革熱病例砍半，感染人數從 396 降到 192，並寫明這相當於給一半人口接種效力 80% 的疫苗。25 個參數帶著來源欄——13 個來自一篇論文、4 個來自另一篇、**7 個來自隊伍自己的濕實驗室**、2 個宣告為假設——而擬合是對照自己報出來的：SSE 1.9029×10⁶、RMSE 97.0582，並把這個偏差稱為顯著。2025 年真正被擬合的只有一個關於分析溫度與 pH 的反應曲面；Michaelis-Menten、產物抑制和 Langmuir-Hinshelwood 那三節定義了符號，然後**從來沒有被賦值**——整個網站找不到任何一個 Vmax、Km 或 kcat，而那些方程式是以圖片出貨的。2026 年統計實作是整個場上最好的，而**完全沒有一個關於那套工程化系統的機制模型**：動力學是一條借來的 CcaSR Hill 曲線——wiki 自己說沒有任何東西在 20 L 尺度上檢驗過它——加上一個已發表的規則式感染模型，而隊伍自己擬合的那個模型，是一個架在氣象與縣市稻作產量上的統計指數。統計每一年都變好，而模型不再承重。這就是整條軌跡，而它跟獎項紀錄完全吻合。

cards.title: Three winners, and not one of them was the best-validated team on its own slate
cards.title_zh: 三位得獎者，沒有一位是自己那張名單上驗證做得最好的
cards.body: 2024's winner IEA published no equation, no parameter, no statistic and no validation, and left the iGEM boilerplate on the page. 2025's winner GreatBay-SCIE had one R² and no computational error bars, while Lambert-GA on the same slate reported a temporal hold-out, leave-one-year-out cross-validation, AICc selection and Tukey intervals — and was a nominee. 2026's winner Lambert-GA reports **no RMSE, R² or residual for any of its four models**. The category has not rewarded inferential machinery in three seasons.
cards.body_zh: 2024 年的得獎者 IEA 沒有發表方程式、沒有參數、沒有統計量、沒有驗證，還把 iGEM 的樣板文字留在頁面上。2025 年的得獎者 GreatBay-SCIE 只有一個 R²、計算結果全無誤差棒，而同一張名單上的 Lambert-GA 報了時間序列保留集、leave-one-year-out 交叉驗證、AICc 選擇和 Tukey 區間——結果是入圍。2026 年的得獎者 Lambert-GA **四個模型全部沒有 RMSE、R² 或殘差**。這個類別三季以來都沒有在獎勵推論機制。
chips: best-validated team was a nominee each time
chips_zh: 三位得獎者，三次顛倒
驗證最強的那支每次都只是入圍
2026 得獎者沒有 RMSE

cards.title: The model has to be load-bearing: delete it and the project falls over
cards.title_zh: 模型必須是承重結構：拿掉它，專案就垮
cards.body: IEA's generative model emitted the enzyme sequences — it was the deliverable. All 18 of GreatBay-SCIE's wet-lab variants exist because a model ranked them. Lambert's pipeline produced its 35 candidates, and its own verdict then demoted the flagship protein component in writing. In each case, remove the model and there is no project left. This is the one property all three winners share, and it is decided in week one, not in the write-up.
cards.body_zh: IEA 的生成模型直接產出那些酵素序列——它就是交付成果。GreatBay-SCIE 送進濕實驗室的 18 個變體，全部是因為模型排序才存在。Lambert 的流程產出它那 35 個候選，而它自己的結論接著在文字上降級了自家旗艦的蛋白質工作。這三個案例裡，把模型拿掉就沒有專案了。這是三位得獎者唯一共有的性質，而它是在第一週決定的，不是在寫 wiki 的時候。
chips: the only property all three share
chips_zh: 拿掉它就什麼都不剩
第一週就決定
三位得獎者唯一共有的性質

cards.title: The 2026 Overgraduate winner won on a model that did not work
cards.title_zh: 2026 研究生組的得獎者，是靠一個做不出來的模型得獎的
cards.body: Toronto asked whether protein-language-model embeddings predict PET-degrading activity under an honest split. The answer was no. It printed **ρ = 0.72 under a leaky split beside ρ = −0.025 under a grouped one**, quantified the leakage it had avoided — 90% to 92% of labelled sequences have a homologous relative elsewhere in the set — ran sequence length and amino-acid composition as dumb baselines, reported that the baselines win, and states that no library has yet been chosen by the model. This is the best evidence in the competition for running the experiment that could overturn your own claim.
cards.body_zh: Toronto 問的是：蛋白質語言模型的嵌入，在一個誠實的切分下能不能預測 PET 降解活性。答案是不能。它把**洩漏切分下的 ρ = 0.72 和分群切分下的 ρ = −0.025 並排印出來**，量化了自己避開的洩漏——有標籤的序列裡有 90% 到 92% 在資料集別處有同源親戚——拿序列長度和胺基酸組成當笨基準線跑，報告說基準線贏了，並寫明至今沒有任何資料庫是由模型選出來的。這是整個競賽裡，支持「做一個可能推翻自己主張的實驗」最強的證據。
chips: the dumb baseline won, and they said so
no library chosen by the model
chips_zh: 笨基準線贏了，而他們寫出來
沒有資料庫是模型選的

cards.title: Four of six university winners won on a supporting quantity, not the headline claim
cards.title_zh: 六支大學組得獎者裡有四支，是靠支援性的量得獎的，不是頭條主張
cards.body: 2025 Peking ran eight models — dissolution, propulsion, adhesion, mucus penetration, binding, signalling, diffusion, epidemiology — and not one addressed the therapeutic efficacy its headline claimed, the widest gap of the six. 2024 Heidelberg modelled staple binding energy, not 3D genome engineering. Only 2024 UToronto and 2026 XJTLU-China are tightly aligned. So a model aimed at a supporting quantity is not the disqualifier it looks like — what matters is whether its answer changes what the team does.
cards.body_zh: 2025 年的 Peking 跑了八個模型——溶離、推進、附著、黏液穿透、結合、訊息傳遞、擴散、流行病學——而沒有一個碰到它頭條所宣稱的治療效力，是六支裡落差最大的。2024 年的 Heidelberg 建的是 staple 結合能的模型，不是三維基因體工程。只有 2024 年的 UToronto 和 2026 年的 XJTLU-China 是緊密對齊的。所以瞄準一個支援性的量，並不是它看起來的那種致命傷——重點在於它的答案有沒有改變隊伍接下來做什麼。
chips: Peking ran 8 models, none on efficacy
chips_zh: 六支裡四支靠支援性的量
Peking 八個模型，沒一個碰效力

cards.title: Publishing a failed prediction is the entry fee, and the statistics are still free
cards.title_zh: 公開一個失敗的預測是入場費，而統計還空在那裡

It is a floor, not a ranking — the same conclusion this report reaches from the falsification side. cards.body_zh: 2025 年高中組五支裡有四支公開了一個沒有活過量測的預測；2026 年受獎的五支全部也是，六支大學組得獎者裡有五支也是。它是地板，不是排名——跟本報告從否證那一側得到的結論相同。而沒有人在做的是：**六支大學組得獎者沒有一支報 RMSE**、沒有一支報卡方、R² 只出現在一頁上，而 2026 年受獎的五支高中隊伍裡，沒有任何一個機制模型帶著對照自己資料的 R² 或 RMSE。

cards.title: The 2026 Undergraduate winner ran on a CPU and a lockfile
cards.title_zh: 2026 大專組的得獎者，跑在一顆 CPU 和一份 lockfile 上
cards.body: XJTLU-China won the Undergraduate category on NumPy, SciPy, pandas, Biopython, scikit-learn and Matplotlib, with a compute statement one sentence long naming a Windows x64 computer and CPython 3.14. Its advantage was entirely methodological: splits grouped by gene and by promoter motif pair, numeric predictions stated in advance, an ablation ladder, a named held-out metric, a lockfile. In the High School section HongKong-JSS reached 1st Runner-up on a laptop and about **US$357** of hardware, Mingdao took a Best Model slot on Python, Excel and a household glucose meter, and Lambert's winning season used **under US$400** of rented GPU.
cards.body_zh: XJTLU-China 靠 NumPy、SciPy、pandas、Biopython、scikit-learn 和 Matplotlib 拿下大專組，而它的算力宣告只有一句話，寫著一台 Windows x64 電腦和 CPython 3.14。它的優勢完全在方法上：依基因與啟動子 motif 配對做分群切分、事先寫下數值預測、一組消融階梯、一個指名的保留集指標、一份 lockfile。而在高中組，HongKong-JSS 用一台筆電加大約 **357 美元**的硬體拿到第一亞軍，Mingdao 靠 Python、Excel 和一台家用血糖機拿下一個最佳模型席次，而 Lambert 得獎那一季只用了**不到 400 美元**的租用 GPU。
chips_zh: 只用 CPU，pip 裝得起來
JSS：一台筆電加 357 美元
Lambert：不到 400 美元的 GPU

cards.title: What money actually buys, and it is a short list
cards.title_zh: 錢真正買到的東西，而那是一份很短的清單
cards.body: Six things in the winning set are resources rather than effort: an institutional HPC allocation — 2024 Heidelberg ran on a cluster free only to Baden-Württemberg institutions and still could not finish processing 2 TB of trajectory; A100-class cards for days; hundreds of GPU-hours, as in 851.6 across up to 80 cards; production all-atom and coarse-grained MD; structure prediction in the thousands, such as 1.79 million ESMFold2 folds; and a wet lab able to produce the measurement that settles the model. Everything else on the winners' pages is discipline.
cards.body_zh: 得獎者這一組裡有六件事屬於資源、不屬於努力：機構級的 HPC 配額——2024 年的 Heidelberg 跑在一座只對巴登-符騰堡機構免費的叢集上，而且還是沒能把 2 TB 的軌跡資料處理完；連續數日的 A100 等級顯卡；數百 GPU 小時，例如在最多 80 張卡上跑掉的 851.6 小時；量產級的全原子與粗粒化分子動力學；上千次的結構預測，例如 179 萬次 ESMFold2 摺疊；以及一座做得出「能定案那個模型」的那個量測的濕實驗室。得獎者頁面上其他每一件事，都是紀律。
chips_zh: HPC 配額是機構層級的
80 張卡上的 851.6 GPU 小時
179 萬次摺疊

cards.title: Held-out validation went from absent to central in one season, above High School
cards.title_zh: 保留集驗證在一季之內從缺席變成核心，但那是在高中組之上
cards.body: All four of the 2024 and 2025 university winners had nothing held back from fitting. **Both 2026 university winners made held-out split design the centrepiece** — XJTLU grouped by gene and motif pair, Toronto by connected homology component with the leakage counted. High School runs the same direction more slowly: 0 of 5, then 1 of 5, then 2 of 5. But the 2026 High School award still went to a team with no fit statistic over a team with held-out years and a date-stamped pre-registration. Read it as what will be expected, not as what is already priced in.
cards.body_zh: 2024 與 2025 年四支大學組得獎者，全部沒有從擬合中保留任何資料。**2026 年兩支大學組得獎者都把保留集的切分設計當成核心**——XJTLU 依基因與 motif 配對分群，Toronto 依連通同源成分分群並把洩漏數出來。高中組往同一個方向走，但慢得多：0 比 5，然後 1 比 5，然後 2 比 5。可是 2026 年高中組這個獎，還是給了一支沒有任何擬合統計量的隊伍，而不是那支有保留年份和日期戳記預先登記的隊伍。所以要把它讀成「將來會被期待的事」，不是「已經被計入的事」。
chips: expected soon, not priced in yet
chips_zh: 四支裡零支，然後兩支全中
高中組：0、1、2，分母都是 5
快被期待，但還沒被計入

cards.title: GEMS-Taiwan's statistics improved every year and its model stopped being load-bearing
cards.title_zh: GEMS-Taiwan 的統計每年變好，而它的模型不再承重
cards.body: 2024, the Grand Prize year: a **ten-equation SEI-SEIR vector-host system, a mechanistic model of the team's own intervention, and it was the headline claim** — 450 ovitraps per 2,500 people halving dengue cases, with 25 parameters carrying a source column and 7 of them measured on the team's own bench, and SSE and RMSE reported against itself. 2025: only a response surface for assay temperature and pH is fitted; the kinetic sections define symbols and are **never parameterised**, with no Vmax, Km or kcat anywhere. 2026: the best statistical practice in the field, and **no mechanistic model of the engineered system at all** — a borrowed Hill curve nothing tests at 20 L, a published infection rule, and a statistical index over weather and county rice yield.
cards.body_zh: 2024 年，總冠軍那一季：一個**十條方程式的 SEI-SEIR 病媒—宿主系統，一個關於隊伍自己這套干預手段的機制模型，而且它就是頭條主張**——每 2,500 人放 450 個誘卵器把登革熱病例砍半，25 個參數帶著來源欄、其中 7 個是隊伍自己量的，而且 SSE 與 RMSE 是對照自己報出來的。2025 年：真正被擬合的只有一個關於分析溫度與 pH 的反應曲面；那些動力學段落定義了符號然後**從來沒有被賦值**，整站找不到一個 Vmax、Km 或 kcat。2026 年：統計實作是全場最好的，而**完全沒有一個關於那套工程化系統的機制模型**——一條沒有任何東西在 20 L 尺度檢驗過的借來 Hill 曲線、一條已發表的感染規則，以及一個架在氣象與縣市稻作產量上的統計指數。
chips: 2026: no mechanistic model of its own system
chips_zh: 2024：10 條微分方程、7 個自己量的參數
2025：符號定義了，從未賦值
2026：沒有自己系統的機制模型

checklist: Decide in week one what the model is for, and make it something the project cannot do without. Every one of the three winners has a model that produced the thing the wet lab built, or settled whether a method works at all. A model written up afterwards to explain results already in hand has not won this category in three seasons.

Split your data before you fit anything, and split it by the thing that leaks. XJTLU-China held out by gene and by promoter motif pair; Toronto split by connected homology component and then counted the leakage it had avoided. This is a few lines of code and it is the most credit-bearing thing on either page.

Report the dishonest number next to the honest one. Toronto printed a correlation of 0.72 under a leaky split beside minus 0.025 under a grouped one. It costs nothing and it is the clearest possible demonstration that you understand your own method.

Run a baseline so dumb it would be embarrassing to lose to, then say so if you lose. Sequence length. Amino-acid composition. Last year's number. A straight trend line. Toronto lost to sequence length, published it, and won the category.

Write a number down before the measurement that will settle it, with a pass criterion and a date. GEMS-Taiwan has done this twice and is the only team in the cohort to pre-register with stated pass criteria — keep it, and point the next one at the engineered system rather than at an agronomic proxy.

Parameterise your own system. If a kinetic section defines symbols it never fills in, it reads as an intention, not a model. Mingdao's third model contains no borrowed numbers at all, every parameter measured in Models 1 and 2 at the conditions the real system runs at — and that is reachable with a plate reader and a glucose meter.

Put a source column on every parameter, and label the assumptions as assumptions. Three of the recognised teams do this; it is the cheapest credibility on the page, and the row where measurement stops is the row a judge will ask about.

Report a goodness-of-fit statistic for the principal model, because almost nobody does. Not one of the six university winners reports RMSE, and no mechanistic model among the recognised 2026 High School teams carries an R² or RMSE against its own data. This is an open differentiator, not a floor.

State the compute floor in one sentence. The 2026 Undergraduate winner's reads: a Windows x64 computer, CPython 3.14, and an extracted copy of the launcher. Saying the work runs on a laptop is itself a reproducibility claim.

Ship the model as something a stranger can run: a repository with a licence, a lockfile rather than a prose version list, the raw data behind each figure, and the script named per figure. Two of the six university winners published no code licence at all, and only two of the five recognised 2026 High School teams published a URL.

Publish the prediction that failed, in the same place as the one that held. It is the entry fee rather than the edge — four of five, then five of five, then five of six across the three seasons — so a page without one stands out downwards.

Check the arithmetic by hand before freeze. One university winner shipped component energies that do not sum to their stated total and a diffusion coefficient four orders of magnitude from its own inputs. Catching that needs a checklist, not a cluster.
checklist_zh: 在第一週就決定模型是要做什麼用的，而且要讓它成為專案少了它就做不下去的東西。三位得獎者的模型，每一個都產出了濕實驗室真正去建的那個東西，或是定案了某個方法到底行不行。事後補寫來解釋已經在手上的結果的模型，三季以來沒有拿下過這個類別。
在擬合任何東西之前先切分資料，而且要依「會洩漏的那個東西」來切。XJTLU-China 依基因、也依啟動子 motif 配對留出；Toronto 依連通同源成分切分，然後把自己避開的洩漏數出來。這是幾行程式碼，而且是這兩頁上最能換到分數的東西。
把不誠實的那個數字擺在誠實的那個旁邊。Toronto 把洩漏切分下的相關係數 0.72 和分群切分下的負 0.025 並排印出來。這不花錢，而且是你理解自己方法最清楚的證明。
跑一個笨到「輸給它會很難看」的基準線，然後如果真的輸了就寫出來。序列長度。胺基酸組成。去年的數字。一條直線趨勢。Toronto 輸給了序列長度，把它發表出來，然後拿下了這個類別。
在那個會定案的量測之前，先把一個數字寫下來，附上通過標準和日期。GEMS-Taiwan 已經做過兩次，而且是這群隊伍裡唯一附上明確通過標準做預先登記的——這個習慣要留住，而下一次要把它指向那套工程化系統，不是指向一個農業上的代理量。
把自己的系統賦值。如果一個動力學段落定義了符號卻從來沒有填進數字，它讀起來是一個意圖，不是一個模型。Mingdao 的第三個模型完全沒有任何借來的數字，每一個參數都是在模型一與模型二裡、在真實系統實際運行的條件下量出來的——而這件事用一台微量盤判讀儀和一台血糖機就做得到。
每一個參數都加一欄來源，而且把假設標成假設。受獎隊伍裡有三支這樣做；這是頁面上最便宜的可信度，而「量測在哪一列停下來」那一列，正是評審會問的那一列。
為主要模型報一個擬合統計量，因為幾乎沒有人在做。六支大學組得獎者沒有一支報 RMSE，而 2026 年受獎的高中隊伍裡，沒有任何一個機制模型帶著對照自己資料的 R² 或 RMSE。這是一個還開著的差異化空間，不是地板。
用一句話寫清楚算力門檻。2026 年大專組得獎者的那一句是：一台 Windows x64 電腦、CPython 3.14，以及一份解壓好的啟動器。說清楚這份工作可以在筆電上跑，本身就是一種可重現性的宣告。
把模型以「陌生人可以直接跑」的形式出貨：一個帶授權條款的 repo、一份 lockfile 而不是一串文字版版本清單、每張圖背後的原始資料，以及對應到每張圖的程式檔名。六支大學組得獎者裡有兩支完全沒有發表程式碼授權，而 2026 年受獎的五支高中隊伍裡只有兩支給了網址。
把失敗的那個預測，發表在跟成功的那個同一個地方。它是入場費而不是優勢——三季下來分別是五支裡四支、五支全中、六支裡五支——所以沒有的那一頁，是往下突出的。
凍結之前用手把算術對一遍。有一支大學組得獎者出貨的分項能量加起來不等於自己寫的總和，而一個擴散係數跟自己的輸入值差了四個數量級。抓到這種錯需要一份檢查表，不需要一座叢集。
method: Cohort: every team recognised in the Best Model category in 2024, 2025 and 2026 — 49 recipients, 9 outright winners and 40 nominees — identified from three captures of iGEM's own award data held in this project's working files. The 15 High School recipients were read in full on the twelve fields reported here: project headline claim, what the model was about, model class, parameter provenance, fitting method and statistics reported, validation design, a prediction that could have failed, whether a model result changed a decision, code and reproducibility, tooling, compute floor, and one repeatable number. The six Undergraduate and Overgraduate winners were read on the same fields as a resource ceiling. The 2026 High School set was read from the 106-team corpus in this report; the 2024 and 2025 sets were read from the live season wikis, with GEMS-Taiwan's 2024 pages taken partly from a local cache because that site is a client-rendered single-page application whose model route returns HTTP 404 on a direct fetch. Two 2026 recipients, Usherbrooke and Tsinghua, are outside the corpus and were not read. Limits: n is 15 in the section that matters, five slots a season, so no figure here supports a causal claim, and awards are not independent of project quality — every pattern reported is co-occurrence. Where a wiki did not state something, it is recorded as not stated rather than inferred.
method_zh: 樣本：2024、2025、2026 三季所有在最佳模型類別受獎的隊伍——49 支受獎者，9 支得獎、40 支入圍——依據本專案工作檔案裡三份 iGEM 官方獎項資料的擷取紀錄辨識。15 支高中組受獎隊伍全部依本文所報的十二個欄位完整讀過：專案頭條主張、模型處理的是什麼、模型類別、參數出處、擬合方法與實際報出的統計量、驗證設計、一個可能失敗的預測、模型結果有沒有改變某個決定、程式碼與可重現性、工具、算力門檻，以及一個可重複的數字。六支大專組與研究生組的得獎者以同樣欄位讀過，作為資源上限的對照。2026 年高中組那一組是從本報告的 106 支隊伍語料庫讀的；2024 與 2025 年兩組是從各賽季的線上 wiki 讀的，其中 GEMS-Taiwan 2024 年的頁面有一部分取自本機快取，因為那個網站是前端渲染的單頁應用，它的 model 路徑在直接抓取時會回傳 HTTP 404。2026 年有兩支受獎隊伍 Usherbrooke 與 Tsinghua 不在語料庫內，未讀。界線：在真正相關的那個組別裡 n 是 15，每季五個名額，所以本文沒有任何數字支持因果主張，而獎項與專案品質本來就不獨立——這裡報告的每一個模式都是同時發生關係。凡 wiki 沒有寫的，都記為未說明，不做推論。
